prompt:
Static wide shot along the promenade at night. The small dark phone already in the air keeps rising in a long high arc out over the river, then falls and disappears into the water far from the railing with a tiny splash glinting in the reflected city lights. The woman in the camel cardigan follows through with her whole body and throws both arms up, glass in one hand; her friend staggers back laughing. The camera, railing and bridge stay perfectly still. Sound: wind off the water, a far-off splash, shrieks of laughter. No music.

Thanks.
